text:
maria: Quick Q about /v1/embeddings contract — need a short set of bullets so I can update docs/tests. If a client sends mixed inputs in one batch (e.g. null, "", long text): do we preserve positions? what do we return for empty string vs null? how do we signal truncation? also what's the current per-request item limit?

sam: Short answers first: preserve positions (always). null => return null at that index. empty string => compute embedding for the empty string (i.e., not a zero vector). Truncation is done by token count (model input limit) and we should surface a per-item flag in response.meta when we trim. Per-request item limit: 1024 items by default; also enforce a total payload char limit (200k) to prevent OOMs.

lee: +1 on preserve positions. Important for downstream repro/indices. Also note: vector dimension is model-specific and must be in response.meta.dimension (string/int). That way clients don't hard-code 1536.

priya: Can we add an optional query param preserve_input_positions=true/false? default true for backward compatibility. If false, server may compact out nulls and return only vectors (legacy clients might want that for smaller payloads). But default must maintain current behavior (positions preserved).

sam: Implementation notes for docs/tests: example request snippet we want in the contract:```json
{"model":"embed-2025-small","input":["hello","","a very long document...","\u0000","another"]}
```And the response shape we want to show:```json
{
  "model":"embed-2025-small",
  "meta":{"dimension":1536, "truncated_indices":[2]},
  "data":[
    {"embedding":[0.001, -0.23, ...]},
    {"embedding":[0.002, 0.14, ...]},
    {"embedding":[0.01, -0.05, ...]},
    {"embedding":null},
    {"embedding":[0.12, 0.003, ...]}
  ]
}
```Notes: - index 1 is empty string: we compute its embedding. - index 3 is null: we return null. - truncated_indices is optional (only present when any items were clipped). - data length == input length (preserve positions).

maria: Good. For truncation policy text we'll say: "truncate by token count using model tokenizer; prefer prefix retention (keep leading tokens)". Is that what runtime will do?

sam: Yes runtime will clip trailing tokens (prefix-kept) to maximize semantic start. We'll add a small note: we do token-based clipping, but clients can call chunking helper in SDK if they want semantics-preserving chunk overlap.

lee: Also add a compatibility note: older clients that expect arrays-of-vectors only (no nulls) should set preserve_input_positions=false. We'll add a deprecation path: after 6 months we can consider stricter warnings but keep default behavior stable.

priya: One more: response format for embedding values should be floats with 6dp-ish precision in examples, but real payload can be full precision. And include header X-Redwood-Embed-Model to fast-check dimension.

maria: Perfect. I'll update the API page and add unit tests in embed-contract: tests should assert: length matches inputs, null preserved, empty string not null, truncated_indices present when expected. @sam can you review the PR when I open it?

sam: Yup I'll review. Thanks.

deploy-bot: docs branch "embed-contract/handle-null-empty" created and CI started :rocket:

maria: Awesome, thanks everyone — I'll post the PR link here when ready.
